notes:
Short-form CRM notes / call highlights:
- Inbound SMB: TiltBay builds an embeddable developer docs/chat widget for dev teams. Self-serve signup on hosted API; low friction eval.
- Primary pain: latency complaints from beta users. Quote from Marco (CTO): "Users notice a 400-800ms lag on some flows — it feels sluggish compared to local app UX."
- Current setup: using JS SDK, connecting to default region (us-central) from a Node.js server in GCP us-east1 via a single connection pool. No streaming enabled (post/await).
- Observed behavior: intermittent p95 spikes during simple chat completions and code generation. Token lengths average 240 tokens per request (prompt + user history), responses ~120 tokens.
- Customer expectations: <200ms p50, p95 target <= 400ms for interactive chat. Cost sensitivity moderate (SMB budget).
- Immediate suggested remediation (shared in email):
  * Region: encourage switching client to nearest Redwood region; run quick A/B: us-east vs us-central vs us-west. Many latency issues resolved by moving to same-cloud-region as app.
  * Timeouts/retries: set client timeout to 3s initially, 2s for interactive UX if using streaming; exponential backoff for 429/5xx.
  * Prompt guidance: trim system + user history, use summary tokens for context; aim to keep prompt <=150 tokens for sub-200ms p50.
  * Streaming: flip to streaming responses for chat UI to reduce perceived latency even if total completion time similar.
  * Connection pooling: enable keep-alive and reuse HTTP/2 session from server to Redwood to avoid TLS handshake overhead.
  * Model choices: recommend smaller low-latency model variant for chat-first flows; reserve higher-capacity model for heavy code-gen endpoints.
  * Caching: prefix cache for static system instructions and frequent queries.
- POC proposal: two-week A/B: (A) region switch + connection pooling + streaming; (B) prompt truncation + smaller model + caching. Measure p50/p95, cost delta.
- Security: SOC2 noted; need SSO/SAML earlier in Q2. They want audit logs & retention options (asked for security FAQ link).
- Quote: "If we can get p95 below 400ms and standardize latency across regions, we'll push to paid next quarter."
- AE notes: customer friendly, technical; low friction for hosted_api trial expansion. Provide short checklist and proposed redwood SDK config snippets (sent in drive doc).
- Follow-up action: schedule 30-min technical deep dive with Priya and engineering to configure POC, collect logs (app traces + request ids), and confirm region preference.
